__prompts__.destination_name: The name of the destination, in CamelCase (e.g., 'MyDestination'). [bold red]Must be a valid Python identifier[/] - use letters and numbers only, no hyphens, spaces, or special characters. This will be used for Python class names.
__prompts__.target_id: The ID of the target, in kebab-case (e.g., 'target-mydestination')
__prompts__.library_name: The name of the library, in snake_case (e.g., 'target_mydestination'). This is how the library will be imported in Python.
__prompts__.include_agent_instructions: Include an agent instructions file? AGENTS.md is the cross-tool standard; CLAUDE.md is specific to Claude Code.
__prompts__.base_url: The base URL of the API
__prompts__.auth_method: Authentication style: Bearer Token, Basic Auth, API Key, or OAuth2 (drives client authenticators, sample `.secrets/config.json`, and whether `auth.py` is kept after generation).
__prompts__.sinks: Comma-separated sinks: each must be `StreamName | record` or `StreamName | batch`. StreamName must be a valid Python identifier (letters, digits, underscores only; no spaces or punctuation). Invalid or empty input falls back to `Fallback | record`. Example: `Contacts | record, Accounts | batch`
